contributions.claim: CJP accuses authorities of mass detentions of members ahead of a planned Saturday Delhi protest.
contributions.uncertainty: Party allegation, not independently confirmed; planned protest not evidence it occurred.

contributions.claim: Thousands expected at planned Delhi march amid near-daily demonstrations over voter-roll revision and election commissioner's resignation.

relations.reason: Same movement and specific election grievance link detention allegation to continuing protests, without conflating Mumbai gathering and detentions.

delta_expectations.reason: New allegation of coercive action is material.
Future demonstration plan may be included as context, not as a completed occurrence.
